cases.name: maillist-tests-parse-index-reads-thread-rows
cases.purpose: A public-inbox index becomes thread rows with date, size and nesting.

cases.name: maillist-tests-parse-thread-keeps-messages-and-senders
cases.purpose: A thread document yields its subject, senders and reply nesting.

cases.name: maillist-tests-classify-lines-names-quotes-and-patches
cases.purpose: Body classification marks quotes, diff hunks and prose with stable ids.

cases.name: maillist-tests-parse-author-reads-the-from-header
cases.purpose: A raw message's From header becomes the list's sender, decoded and unfolded.

cases.name: maillist-tests-day-labels-follow-the-calendar
cases.purpose: Timestamps read as a clock today and as yesterday before that.

cases.name: maillist-tests-session-syncs-a-local-archive
cases.purpose: A session lists a local archive's threads and opens one with its messages.

cases.name: maillist-tests-read-and-star-survive-a-restart
cases.purpose: An opened thread stays read and a starred thread stays starred after a restart.

cases.name: maillist-tests-unanswered-index-keeps-the-list
cases.purpose: An archive answer without thread rows fails the sync and keeps the stored list.

cases.name: maillist-tests-proxy-route-answers-through-the-configured-proxy
cases.purpose: A proxy route sends the archive request to the proxy named by maillist-proxy.

cases.name: maillist-tests-auto-retries-a-stalled-direct-attempt
cases.purpose: A direct attempt that never answers retries through the proxy instead of waiting for the request timeout.

cases.name: maillist-tests-dead-proxy-route-still-reaches-the-archive
cases.purpose: A proxy route whose endpoint is not running still reaches the archive directly.

cases.name: maillist-tests-failed-routes-name-every-endpoint
cases.purpose: A request that reaches nothing names the proxy and the archive it could not connect to.

cases.name: maillist-tests-http-error-answer-is-readable
cases.purpose: An archive that answers with an HTTP error reports that status instead of url.el's error shape.

cases.name: maillist-tests-lists-do-not-share-stored-threads
cases.purpose: Threads are stored per archive, so another list does not show them.

cases.name: maillist-tests-compile-query-maps-fields-and-marks
cases.purpose: Reader search syntax becomes an archive query plus local mark filters.

cases.name: maillist-tests-local-mark-filters-narrow-the-list
cases.purpose: is:unread and is:starred filter the visible rows without a request.

cases.name: maillist-tests-failed-search-keeps-the-open-thread
cases.purpose: A search the archive cannot answer reports and leaves the reader alone.

cases.name: maillist-tests-reply-targets-the-list-or-the-author
cases.purpose: A reply addresses the list; a private reply addresses the last sender.

cases.name: maillist-tests-scope-shows-starred-and-unread-rows
cases.purpose: The starred and unread scopes filter the rows the list shows.

cases.name: maillist-tests-long-thread-shows-newest-messages-first
cases.purpose: A thread starts with a window of new messages and grows on demand.

cases.name: maillist-tests-refresh-keeps-threads-the-index-dropped
cases.purpose: A refresh merges the index page into the stored list, keeping older threads and their marks.

cases.name: maillist-tests-read-mark-waits-for-the-body
cases.purpose: A thread whose body never arrives stays unread after it was selected.

cases.name: maillist-tests-search-rows-stay-out-of-the-cache
cases.purpose: Opening a search result leaves the archive cache's stored facts unchanged.

cases.name: maillist-tests-incompatible-cache-is-rebuilt
cases.purpose: An unreadable cache file is moved aside and rebuilt, so persistence keeps working.

cases.name: maillist-tests-open-mounts-and-close-releases
cases.purpose: Opening mounts a live client with its chrome and closing kills the buffer.

cases.name: maillist-tests-parse-search-reads-message-rows
cases.purpose: A public-inbox search page reads as message rows, which the index parser does not see.

cases.name: maillist-tests-search-fetch-reads-the-archive-answer
cases.purpose: A search request parses the archive's answer with the search reader.

cases.name: maillist-tests-search-falls-back-to-cached-bodies
cases.purpose: A search the archive cannot answer reports from the cached bodies and names the matched text.

cases.name: maillist-tests-unread-mark-survives-a-sync
cases.purpose: Marking a thread unread survives the next sync and the next start.

cases.name: maillist-tests-mark-all-read-covers-the-shown-rows
cases.purpose: Marking all read covers the rows the reader sees and reports how many changed.

cases.name: maillist-tests-older-mail-joins-the-list
cases.purpose: Mail older than the list comes from the archive's date search, grouped by subject and without repeats.

cases.name: maillist-tests-store-answers-while-another-writer-holds-the-file
cases.purpose: A reader answers while another connection to the store is mid-write.

cases.name: maillist-tests-store-prune-keeps-the-newest-rows-and-the-marks
cases.purpose: Retention keeps the newest rows and cached bodies and never drops the reader's marks.

cases.name: maillist-tests-store-settings-round-trip
cases.purpose: A stored setting reads back and a second write replaces it.

cases.name: maillist-tests-open-remembers-the-archive
cases.purpose: A client started without a list opens the archive it opened last.

cases.name: maillist-tests-cached-body-search-names-the-match
cases.purpose: Cached bodies answer a search with the thread and the text that matched.

cases.name: maillist-tests-message-links-lists-addresses-in-order
cases.purpose: A message body yields the addresses a reader can open, trimmed and without repeats.

cases.name: maillist-tests-displayed-links-follow-the-message
cases.purpose: An open thread carries the addresses its messages mention.

cases.name: maillist-tests-open-client-syncs-on-a-schedule
cases.purpose: An open client syncs on a schedule and stops asking the archive once it is closed.

cases.name: maillist-tests-recall-query-walks-the-history
cases.purpose: The search history walk returns the queries the client ran and ends at the archive's list.

cases.name: maillist-tests-thread-url-is-the-archive-page
cases.purpose: A thread's shareable address is the archive's own page for it.

cases.name: maillist-tests-first-sync-marks-nothing-new
cases.purpose: The sync that establishes the list reports no new thread, and a thread a later page adds is marked new.

cases.name: maillist-tests-file-archive-does-not-use-the-proxy
cases.purpose: A file: archive is read directly even when the configured route is the proxy.

cases.name: maillist-tests-torn-store-is-rebuilt
cases.purpose: A store file a crash left unreadable is set aside and rebuilt instead of leaving the client without persistence.

cases.name: maillist-tests-reply-all-copies-the-last-author
cases.purpose: A reply-all keeps the list as recipient and copies the last message's author; the plain reply has no Cc.

cases.name: maillist-tests-next-unread-visits-each-unread-thread-once
cases.purpose: Next-unread walks the unread rows after the selection once and stops at the end.

cases.name: maillist-tests-select-edge-reaches-both-ends
cases.purpose: The list jumps to its first and last row and opens them.

cases.name: maillist-tests-palette-is-shared-while-the-theme-holds
cases.purpose: The palette is reused while the theme holds and follows a face it changes.

cases.name: maillist-tests-a-store-queries-its-own-file
cases.purpose: Search and marks read the SQLite file the store was opened on, not the default one.

cases.name: maillist-tests-http-utf8-response-is-decoded
cases.purpose: HTTP responses carrying UTF-8 bytes decode cleanly without mojibake.

cases.name: maillist-tests-encoded-message-ids-decode-and-round-trip
cases.purpose: Percent-encoded Message-IDs decode canonically and encode once in URLs and mbox links.

cases.name: maillist-tests-offline-cached-thread-survives-refresh-failure
cases.purpose: Opening a cached thread offline keeps its cached messages visible when background refresh fails.

cases.name: maillist-tests-debbugs-reply-targets-bug-address
cases.purpose: Replying in a Debbugs list addresses <bug>@debbugs.gnu.org and excludes own address from Cc.

cases.name: maillist-tests-focused-message-reply-and-ancestor-references
cases.purpose: Focusing an earlier message targets it on reply with its RFC 5322 ancestor References chain.

cases.name: maillist-tests-new-replies-reopen-read-thread-and-mark-new
cases.purpose: A previously read thread whose date or count advances on sync becomes unread and new again.

cases.name: maillist-tests-search-isolation-and-instant-restore
cases.purpose: Clearing a search restores the archive list offline immediately without losing cached threads.

cases.name: maillist-tests-structured-local-search-handles-fields-and-wildcards
cases.purpose: Offline local search evaluates structured field queries, is:read and escapes SQLite LIKE wildcards.

cases.name: maillist-tests-cross-posted-threads-and-shared-messages-stay-isolated
cases.purpose: Cross-posted thread ids across lists and shared messages across threads stay isolated with :parent preserved.

cases.name: maillist-tests-v3-store-migrates-in-place-preserving-marks
cases.purpose: A valid v0.3.0 store migrates in place to composite keys without losing threads or marks.

cases.name: maillist-tests-prune-protects-starred-and-other-lists
cases.purpose: Pruning a list protects starred threads and leaves other lists' cached bodies untouched.

cases.name: maillist-tests-classify-lines-and-links-handle-diffs-quotes-signatures
cases.purpose: Line classification handles diff headers, nested quotes and signatures; link extraction skips quotes and keeps balanced parens.

cases.name: maillist-tests-prev-unread-folding-quotes-and-custom-sources
cases.purpose: Previous-unread, collapse-all, quote toggle, inherit mail transport and custom source persistence work.

cases.name: maillist-tests-native-index-cursor-loads-older-threads
cases.purpose: When the archive index provides a ?t= next cursor, load-older pages thread rows natively.

cases.name: maillist-tests-mounted-regions-and-help
cases.purpose: The mounted client registers ETAF search, threads and reader regions plus in-buffer help notes.

cases.name: maillist-tests-nntp-sync-thread-older-and-incremental-update
cases.purpose: NNTP sync reads XOVER authors, pipelines MIME thread articles, updates incrementally and pages older mail.

cases.name: maillist-tests-nntp-falls-back-to-http-when-unreachable
cases.purpose: When an archive's NNTP endpoint is unreachable, sync and thread reading fall back transparently to HTTP.

cases.name: maillist-tests-unchanged-cached-thread-opens-without-network
cases.purpose: Reopening an unchanged cached thread in a fresh session serves SQLite directly with zero network calls.

cases.name: maillist-tests-dead-proxy-falls-back-once-and-learns-direct-route
cases.purpose: A dead proxy falls back once without duplicating HTTP requests and subsequent requests lead with direct.

cases.name: maillist-tests-body-prefetch-warms-unread-threads-in-background
cases.purpose: Idle background body prefetch caches top uncached unread threads into SQLite for instant opening.
